45/S0.subgoal: Describe the purpose and limitations of quick prototype evaluations versus comprehensive empirical studies.

45/S1.subgoal: List the prerequisites and four stages necessary to conduct a conclusive empirical study.

45/S2.subgoal: Demonstrate how to formulate research questions using a concrete example of a text entry interface.

45/S3.subgoal: Explain how to balance the trade-off between specific testable questions and broad generalized untestable questions.

45/S4.subgoal: Identify and differentiate between independent (factors) and dependent variables used in an experiment.

45/S5.subgoal: Summarize the empirical research process, emphasizing the need for careful variable identification.
